body: MAINLINE-019 complete, ESTIMATE; QUESTIONABLE inputs and PROJECTION panel routes. Both lead families reproduced and re-optimised at every margin. The declared optimistic 24 h sealed-service case needs 535.95 kg (10.96% of lift): aramid least SF 0.608701, aluminium 0.556669. The conservative hot/wet, 0.6 m panel, 24 h battery-pump case needs 4229.07 kg (86.49%): 0.009665 and 0.012716; both are then stiff-branch. These are explicit scenarios, not a measured site envelope. The budget includes both face splices, continuous bond films, exact climate loss, humidity and internal air without double-charging existing allowances. Sealed service is the lightest examined candidate, 30-50 kg, zero pumping W plus 5 W monitoring, conditional on measured leak/thermal limits. Seams alone need 2.68-2.80 m optimistic panels at the old 5% line; full-area bonding consumes almost all that allowance. Required curved thin S200F panels are unverified; 290-versus-303 GPa grade mismatch flagged. Independent mass/pressure arithmetic and dense-search checks pass; 34 source pins verified. Fourteen NFI rows, all assumptions, sensitivities and scripts are pinned. The brief says stop and file; no successor job is named.
